column4: The 13 in-window runs (220 B) are the final4-proven subset of the 1088-B gated USB personality; doc95's 868 B are the complement L1 added in final5. All 1088 B are real code reached only via boot jsr@78106 on strap (FFFF4C&7F)==7D, the FF813A USB-ISR gate, and the FFB0C4>=5 DSP-WRITE gate. analyze.py zeroes RM over CW by construction, so they can never be 'reached'. Keep proven; do NOT add a descent edge (would wrongly mark the gated personality as unconditionally live).

Compiler-emitted switch/case arms and alternate-length variants inside live functions, each sitting after an unconditional bra that skips them, with NO inbound edge of any form and NO indirect jmp in the containing function. No descent rule can legitimately reach them; propose demotion from the proven mask instead.

These leaf subs are reached in the with-seeds descent ONLY as fnindex function-start seeds (each preceded by rts; their sole real callers are the R2 dead arms). L4 doc101 called 066FB4/067250 REACHED 'through off_74472'; off_74472 (0x074472) points only into 0x073Axx-0x07445A, NOT these leaves or their callers. The recon restored 066FBE(10B)+06726A(26B) citing 'proven callers 06AB2A/36,06AE04/10' which R2 shows are dead. Mechanism correction; reconsider whether these leaves are live.
